text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was out walking, led 
along by Sirius Symboli—

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Tch!! What, you're persistent...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I already told you punks... our score's 
settled...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was between you and your pal. 
Things between you and me ain't settled 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hey.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Keep it down. What are you doing? A bunch 
of brats squawking all at once.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Haaah? Oh... Sirius, huh."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you took good care of my 
buddy, so I'm here to say thanks.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. If that's how it is, I won't stop 
you, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I recognize this face. I'm pretty sure my 
junior had some trouble with them before.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Well then, wanna give it a 
shot too?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...— Not interested.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey—! You're a leader too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't you even care about avenging your 
buddy...?!

Running after Sirius Symboli— I find her 
making a phone call to someone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...It's me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I found who you're looking for. She's at 
the freestyle racecourse right now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...That's all I wanted to say. What you 
do next is up to you. See ya."
choice_data_list:
(Could the person on the other end of the 
phone be—!)

text_block_list.text: —Afterward, the prediction came true.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhhhhーーーーーーt!!!!

Sirius Symboli's underclassmen showed up 
at the freestyle racetrack and scored a 
brilliant victory against their fated 
rival Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah!! I win!! Now we're even!!

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...! What a troublesome 
day... Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for contacting me!! 
Thanks to you, Senior, I was able to win 
this time!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who pulled it off. Thank 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, so that's what it was~! 
Sorry for sayin' those nasty things!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. My way is making people pay their 
own tabs. We just have different ways of 
doing things.
choice_data_list:
You both have strong convictions, don't 
you?

You both have strong convictions, don't 
you?

It's all about trusting your partner, 
right.

It's all about trusting your partner, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. My way is making people pay their 
own tabs. We just have different ways of 
doing things.
choice_data_list:
You both have strong convictions, don't 
you?

You both have strong convictions, don't 
you?

It's all about trusting your partner, 
right.

It's all about trusting your partner, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It ain't anything grand. What clicks or 
doesn't click is different for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Then just go after whichever one you 
want. It's as simple as that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... I tend to lose my 
temper pretty easily, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
From a 'guardian's perspective', ya say? 
Heheh, that cool-headed vibe ain't bad 
either!

The hot-blooded Jungle Pocket and the 
cool-headed Sirius Symboli. I was reminded 
once again what dependable leaders they 
both were.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, as if I'd let someone who can't even 
take care of themselves hang around me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I see. I guess that's one way to 
look at it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Well, settlin' things with your own two 
hands is the best way to do it. Maybe I 
oughta take a page outta your book."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh. So you're saying you want to learn 
from me?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Like hell I will! I've got zero 
intention of playing second fiddle to 
anyone!

Sirius Symboli entrusted it to her 
precisely because she had faith in her 
junior. I felt like I had caught another 
glimpse of her immense magnanimity.
